episodes.content: Smash Seriate beat Volley Dalmine 3-1 at home; Giacomo played all four sets.
Weekend in Verona with Martina on 26-27 Feb for her birthday; done (B&B near Piazza delle Erbe, Arena, osteria).
Run the Mezza di Bergamo half marathon (goal under 1h55); done in 1h52'40".
Dentist: cavity filled.
Blood donation at AVIS (morning, before work).
Apply for the hospital-pharmacist call at Papa Giovanni XXIII (deadline Mon 28 Feb); application sent Sun 20 Feb.
Smash Seriate lost 1-3 away at Treviglio (league leaders).
Rear-ended in via Corridoni in the evening coming home from the pharmacy; Giacomo fine (stiff neck), Punto's rear destroyed, other driver at fault.
Lampioni Gialli concert at Alcatraz, Milan, with Martina; cancelled by the band hours before (singer's laryngitis), 2 x 38 euro refunded.
Regional course on vaccinations in pharmacies, Milan, all day; done, now qualified.
Insurance assessor: Punto not worth repairing, to be scrapped; other party's insurer pays 2,100 euro market value.
Job interview at Papa Giovanni XXIII on Thu 24 Mar at 10; done, went well.
Offer for the three-room flat in via Pignolo (top floor, small terrace) accepted.
Smash Seriate beat Stezzano 3-0; Giacomo MVP with 14 points.
Lunch for Ezio's 70th birthday at agriturismo Il Castagneto, Clusone (requested by Rosanna); happened, everyone there incl. Federico and Anna.
Bought a used 2029 Toyota Yaris hybrid, blue, 14,500 euro; Federico lent 1,500 euro for the deposit.
Picked up the Yaris; the Punto went to the scrapyard.
Signed the preliminary contract (compromesso) for via Pignolo.
Deed (rogito) for via Pignolo, first set for Thu 28 Apr; postponed to Fri 24 Jun (mortgage approval delayed).
Move to via Pignolo, first set for the weekend of 30 Apr; postponed to Sat 2 Jul.
Hired as hospital pharmacist at Papa Giovanni XXIII (call on Fri 1 Apr); resigned from Farmacia Santa Grata on 4 Apr, last day Sat 30 Apr, start Mon 2 May.
Smash Seriate beat Osio 3-2 (tie-break 15-13).
Erasmus reunion in Valencia 14-17 Apr with Claire, Pieter, Joanna in a flat in Ruzafa booked by Claire; done (City of Arts and Sciences, Albufera paella, Turia park).
Called his mother from the Albufera for her birthday; friends sang on video.
Repaid Federico the first instalment, 750 euro, by bank transfer.
Repay Federico the second 750-euro instalment in June.
Farewell dinner with Santa Grata colleagues (Irene's proposal) on Fri 29 Apr; happened in a trattoria, gift: a lab coat embroidered «dottor Galenica».
Dentist check-up after the filling, Thu 12 May at 18; outcome never reported.
First day at the Papa Giovanni XXIII hospital pharmacy (oncology compounding).
Smash Seriate lost the playoff semifinal 0-3 to Treviglio; season over.
Bike trip to Monte Isola (Lake Iseo) with Martina, set for Sun 15 May; rained off, done Sun 22 May (lunch in Carzano, Ceriola sanctuary).
Decide in September whether to keep playing volleyball next season.
Second blood donation of the year at AVIS (lunch break).
Federico and Anna expect a baby, due end of August.
Pietro broke his wrist skiing at Foppolo, out six weeks.
Irene Pesenti announced she marries Matteo in June.
Tiziano moves to Lugano for work from 2 Apr, commuting, staying in the team.
Pieter promoted to head of the port logistics team in Rotterdam.
Federico and Anna's baby is a girl, to be named Bianca.

notes.content: Partner Martina Locatelli, freelance graphic designer.
Parents Rosanna and Ezio live in Clusone; brother Federico (software developer) lives in Milan with his wife Anna.
Erasmus friends from Valencia 2015: Claire (Dublin), Pieter (Rotterdam), Joanna (Kraków); next reunion planned in Kraków next year.
Plays amateur CSI volleyball with Smash Seriate: training Wednesday evening, matches on Saturday; teammates Tiziano, Pietro, Omar.
Runs three times a week with a long run on Sunday; donates blood at AVIS.
Qualified to vaccinate in pharmacies (course of 15 March 2033).
